entries.description: Text input that resolves wallet or contract addresses and ENS names.

keyProps.name: value
keyProps.contract: Controlled current input text for an address or ENS name; defaults to an empty string.

keyProps.name: onChange
keyProps.contract: Receives edited input text; with enforceChecksum enabled, valid or all-uppercase addresses are normalized to checksum form, and surrounding whitespace is trimmed on blur. Clearing emits undefined.

keyProps.name: onAccept
keyProps.contract: After debounce and ENS/address resolution, receives { address, name } with a checksum address and normalized ENS name, or undefined when input is invalid or fails checksum enforcement.

keyProps.name: chainId
keyProps.contract: Selects the block-explorer network; ENS resolution remains on mainnet.

keyProps.name: enforceChecksum
keyProps.contract: Defaults true; rejects mixed-case addresses that fail strict EIP-55 validation while accepted output remains checksum formatted.

keyProps.name: hideControls
keyProps.contract: Hides ENS/address toggle, block-explorer link, copy, clear and paste controls.

constraints: Uses wagmi hooks and useQueryClient, so it must render under Wagmi and React-Query providers (GukModulesProvider supplies these)
onChange represents edited input state and may normalize a valid address to checksum form or trim surrounding whitespace on blur; it is separate from accepted output
onAccept is debounced by 300ms and emits a resolved checksum address plus normalized ENS name, or undefined for invalid input/checksum errors
chainId selects the explorer network while ENS resolution always uses mainnet
